WITH txn_with_customer AS (
  SELECT 
    ft.transaction_amount,
    c.gender,
    ft.invoice_number
  FROM Financial_Transactions ft
  INNER JOIN Invoices i ON ft.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  INNER JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  INNER JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
invoice_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    gender,
    AVG(transaction_amount) as inv_avg
  FROM txn_with_customer
  GROUP BY invoice_number, gender
),
gender_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    gender,
    AVG(inv_avg) as gender_avg
  FROM invoice_avgs
  GROUP BY gender
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(gender_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM gender_avgs
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    ga.gender_avg,
    ga.gender_avg - oa.overall_avg as excess
  FROM gender_avgs ga
  CROSS JOIN overall oa
  WHERE ga.gender_avg > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(gender_avg) as avg_kept_gender_level_avgs,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excesses
FROM filtered
